messages:
carla: heads-up from a private customer: telemetry sidecar reached IMDS (169.254.169.254) even though pods do not use hostNetwork. secops-bot alerted.
secops-bot: [ALERT] 2024-06-10T07:12:01Z telemetry-sidecar: unexpected IMDS access from kube-system/telemetry-0
noah: how did that happen? any host proxy or NAT rules?
li: root cause looks like host-level forwarding combined with hostProxy used for legacy hostPort support. pods SNAT->host and proxy forwards IMDS. repro: pod -> hostIP:80 -> forwarded -> IMDS token returned.
tess: mitigation options: 1) immediate host-level DROP for IMDS from pod CIDRs, 2) blocklist at node nft/iptables, 3) remove hostGateway/hostPort from addons, 4) drop CAP_NET_ADMIN from agents.
carla: customer impact: possible IMDS token theft -> potential KMS decrypt if token mapped to cloud role. We require verifying if token was used against our KMS proxy.
analytics: logs show a single GET to /latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials around 2024-06-10T07:05Z from telemetry-sidecar; no direct KMS API calls observed. still treat as high.
noah: triage plan: cordon node, preserve logs, snapshot filesystem, collect iptables-save and nft list, enable net-agent audit forward. INF-5012 opened.
li: quick host hotfix (to push to canary): iptables -I FORWARD -s 10.244.0.0/16 -d 169.254.169.254 -j DROP. using persistent nft recommended.
tess: long-term: OPA admission gate to reject hostNetwork/hostPort/hostGateway in private clusters. also admission mutation to strip annotations that let agents manipulate host iptables.
carla: KMS guidance: private deployments must not use IMDS for envelope keys. Set kms.allow_imds=false by default, require HSM/mTLS unwrap to customer KMS endpoint inside VPC. Priya will update docs.
noah: action items: li push canary drop rule (ETA 60m), tess PR OPA gate (ETA EOD), carla update kms config + docs (ETA EOD), analytics enable net-agent audit forward (ETA 2h).
secops-bot: INF-5012 created and assigned: noah, li, tess  severity=high
carla: keep posting canary results here. if we find token usage against KMS, escalate to immediate key rotation and customer notification.
